Class GUIScreen

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.Screen<GUIScreen>
org.adsl.client.view.gui.screens.GUIScreen
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventVisitor<GUIScreen>
Direct Known Subclasses:
ConnectingScreen, DisconnectedScreen, EndGameScreen, ExitScreen, GameScreen, HomeScreen, LobbyScreen, LoginScreen, TotemPickingScreen
public abstract class GUIScreen extends Screen<GUIScreen>
Base class for every GUI screen. Mirrors TUIScreen for the JavaFX side: each concrete screen owns its FXML controller role, exposes the JavaFX Parent root and reacts to server events via the EventVisitor contract. Default visit methods route events to the "natural" next screen so concrete screens only override what differs.
